forum.title: Need label(s) for ST87M01
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Andrew Neil,

Thank you for your feedback. The label "ST87 series" is now added to the forum "Interface and connectivity ICs".

Best regards,

Maxime
forum.content_text:
Currently, questions are going in the [Interface and connectivity ICs](https://community.st.com/t5/interface-and-connectivity-ics/bd-p/interface-connectivity-ics-forum) forum, but there don't seem to be any suitable labels:

![Image1.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e2b4e51d-030c-272d-3753-a06889c8a13f.png "Image1.png")

I don't think 'Low Power RF Solutions' really covers it?

The Product Page on the main website comes under 'Wireless connectivity > Long range > NB-IoT products':

![Image2.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/77fbf9d2-2903-a93d-9267-e2fe42625bd4.png "Image2.png")

So I guess that would be a good set of labels?
